primary_hypothesis: On the same memory histories, query-conditioned sequence-level contrastive ranking of the correct queried value against another current key value improves free generation and both-correct counterfactual pairs versus positive-NLL-only training with identical candidate scoring compute.
optimizer: restore G8C AdamW state; stage3 LR cosine 0.0002 to 0.00004; betas and weight_decay from parent; clip1

objective.query_contrast: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.5*mean softplus(0.5 + nll_positive - nll_counterfactual_answer)
objective.nll_control: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.0*mean counterfactual-answer NLL; negative candidates still share the same forward graph/tensor shape
objective.sequence_score: length-normalized log probability of F=<integer> plus EOS under the same prompt

data.split_rule: split by query-invariant memory history canonical group before rendering; all query variants of one history stay in one split
data.chronology: per-key write chronology retained in canonicalization
data.denied: all available G5S parent and G8C fresh canonical groups; G8C held is never training data

free_generation: prompt strings only; greedy unrestricted byte259; max32 new bytes; EOS required; parser expects one terminal F=<integer>; no solver/case/gold input
teacher_forced_diagnostic: positive-vs-counterfactual sequence-score margin is reported separately and is not free-generation accuracy
selection: fixed step600 only; validation and held never select checkpoint or hyperparameters
scope: small memory-addressing mechanism test; NOT a 300-800M model, NOT broad reasoning/code evidence, NOT Qwen parity
next_if_positive: port only the verified objective/mechanism into a broader generative backbone and then test fresh reasoning/code data before scale
next_if_negative: reject this objective at this scale and test an architectural query readout/gate separately; do not merely extend updates
